text:
alex gutierrez: quick check — planning to add structured logs for LLM function calls in staging to help debug tool integrations. thinking of logging name + arguments as JSON. any objections on pii surface area?

maya chen: do you mean full function_call.arguments from the model response or our parsed args after validation?

alex gutierrez: full model-provided arguments initially, because some failures only reproduce with raw args. here's an example snippet we'd log (staging only, 7d retention):

```json
{
  \"request_id\": \"req_123\",
  \"model\": \"gpt-4-xxl\",
  \"function_call\": {
    \"name\": \"create_invoice\",
    \"arguments\": {
      \"customer_name\": \"Jane Doe\",
      \"email\": \"jane@example.com\",
      \"line_items\": [{\"desc\": \"SaaS subscription\", \"qty\": 1}]
    }
  }
}
```

ria patel: :eyes: logging emails/phone numbers is a no-go unless we redact/hash them first. How will access be controlled?

samops: if it's staging-only with short TTL and only SRE+devex have read access, that might be acceptable. Recommend pseudonymize email (sha256) and remove tokens. Also add an audit tag on who requested the dump.

security-bot: Redwood policy excerpt: do not persist unredacted PII in logs beyond ephemeral troubleshooting without documented approval. For staging exceptions, you need an owner, retention window, ACL, and post-mortem to prove removal.

maya chen: propose this flow: 1) redact emails/phones in-collector (replace with sha256), 2) strip any bearer/api tokens from arguments, 3) mark logs with `debug_dump:staging` and 7-day TTL, 4) request approval in #eng-security with justification.

alex gutierrez: sounds good. I'll implement collector-side redaction and token scrub, then post a short approval request here with the justification and list of people who need access.

ria patel: approve for staging with those controls. please include the scrubbed->raw replay procedure in the approval request (who can unmask and why).

samops: I'll set up ACLs and a temp role for the team. ping me when it's ready and I'll run the TTL enforcement job. :thumbsup:

alex gutierrez: thanks all — will follow the flow and post the approval ask shortly.
